cats.name: ginger
cats.appearance: a warm orange ginger tabby with a pale cream muzzle, chest and paw tips, green eyes, short orange stripes
cats.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / game animation sprite sheet.
Reference image is the USER-CHOSEN CAT DESIGN, not a background to preserve. Match these adorable pixel chibi kittens closely: huge gently tilted heads, little bodies, tiny noses, friendly round dark pupils with one small glint, subtly coloured lower irises, pink ears and pads. Pixel art with clean, purposeful pixel clusters and dark clean outlines, no blur. Keep the cat identity and proportions CONSISTENT in ALL frames.
Create a production animation SPRITE SHEET on genuine transparent alpha, no scene, no ground, no shadows, no writing, no grid lines, no labels. Landscape image, EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of EIGHT EQUAL CELLS. Each cell contains the SAME SINGLE CAT, completely inside the cell with generous clear margins. Uniform character scale throughout, same baseline near bottom of each cell and aligned head position where applicable. No overlap across cells. Entire cat including its tail and ears visible.
Reading order:
TOP row col1 neutral sitting with open eyes and both paws resting; col2 the SAME pose with both eyes softly shut for a blink; col3 happy small head tilt, left paw raised in a friendly wave showing pink pads; col4 same waving pose with paw slightly higher, eyes happily smiling.
BOTTOM row col1 walking left on FOUR legs, front paw forward; col2 same walking left with alternating leg positions; col3 walking left passing pose with paws under body; col4 curled up asleep, eyes closed and tail wrapped snugly round body.
These are distinct usable animation frames. The first two must align exactly so a blink does not jump in size; the three walk frames must form a coherent little walking cycle at a single scale. Big head, compact kitten body, anatomy clearly feline.
Only this character: a warm orange ginger tabby with a pale cream muzzle, chest and paw tips, green eyes, short orange stripes.
